Di-encode Base85 charset: 0-9A-Za-z!#$%&amp;()*+-;&lt;=&gt;?@^_`{|}~</div></div></div></div><div class="px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 bg-[var(--surface-2)] border-t border-[var(--border)] mono text-[10px] leading-[1.5] text-[var(--ink-3)] flex gap-3"><span id="params-foot">m_cost=262144 (256MB) • t=4 • p=1 • hashLen=32 • AES-GCM 256-bit • IV 12B • Salt 16B</span></div></div><div class="mt-6 rounded-[16px] border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--surface-2)]/80 p-4"><h3 class="serif text-[14px] font-semibold mb-2">Cara kerja mode paranoid negara</h3><ol id="howto" class="mono text-[11px] leading-[1.7] text-[var(--ink-2)] list-decimal pl-4 space-y-1"><li>Generate salt 16-byte &amp; IV 12-byte random via Web Crypto.</li><li>Sandi dinormalisasi (NFKC) lalu diturunkan jadi kunci 32-byte dengan Argon2id asli (RFC 9106, WebAssembly): 256MB, t=4, p=1. Berjalan di Web Worker agar halaman tidak membeku. Jika perangkat tidak mampu 256MB, turun ke 128MB/64MB (dicatat di header) disertai peringatan.</li><li>Enkripsi plaintext pakai AES-GCM 256-bit. Gabung biner [header|salt|iv|ciphertext+tag]; header ikut diautentikasi.</li><li>Encode biner ke Base85 (alfabet RFC 1924, 4 byte → 5 char) – sekitar 6% lebih pendek dari Base64.</li><li>Dekripsi: decode Base85 → baca header → derive kunci dengan parameter yang sama → AES-GCM decrypt. Sandi salah atau data diubah → gagal.</li></ol><p id="howto-note" class="mono text-[10px] text-[var(--ink-3)] mt-3">Catatan: Argon2id memakai implementasi mandiri (C → WebAssembly) yang diuji silang dengan libargon2 dan OpenSSL. Semua perhitungan terjadi di perangkatmu; tidak ada data dikirim ke server. Sandi hilang = data tidak bisa dipulihkan.</p></div><div id="page-foot" class="mt-6 text-center mono text-[10px] text-[var(--ink-3)]">Single file • Argon2id WASM • Tanpa server • Mobile 480px • Krem klasik</div></div></div></div>
  <script id="kdf-src">/* KDF Argon2id (WebAssembly). Dipakai di Web Worker maupun di main thread. */
(function (root) {
  "use strict";

  var WASM_B64 = "";
  var PAGE = 65536;
  var MIN_PAGES = 3; /* harus sama dengan --initial-memory pada build.sh */

  function b64ToBytes(b64) {
    var bin = atob(b64);
    var out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return out;
  }

  var modulePromise = null;
  function getModule() {
    if (!modulePromise) modulePromise = WebAssembly.compile(b64ToBytes(WASM_B64));
    return modulePromise;
  }

  function align(x, a) {
    return Math.ceil(x / a) * a;
  }

  /**
   * Argon2id (RFC 9106, v1.3).
   * @param {Uint8Array} password
   * @param {Uint8Array} salt        minimal 8 byte
   * @param {{memKiB:number,timeCost:number,parallelism?:number,hashLen?:number}} opts
   * @returns {Promise<Uint8Array>}  tag sepanjang hashLen
   * Melempar RangeError jika perangkat tidak dapat mengalokasikan memori.
   */
  async function argon2id(password, salt, opts) {
    var memKiB = opts.memKiB;
    var t = opts.timeCost;
    var p = opts.parallelism || 1;
    var hashLen = opts.hashLen || 32;

    var mod = await getModule();
    var memory = new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: MIN_PAGES });
    var inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(mod, { env: { memory: memory } });

    var pwdPtr = align(inst.exports.__heap_base.value, 16);
    var saltPtr = align(pwdPtr + password.length, 16);
    var outPtr = align(saltPtr + salt.length, 16);
    var memPtr = align(outPtr + hashLen, 64);
    var blocks = 4 * p * Math.floor(memKiB / (4 * p));
    var pages = Math.ceil((memPtr + blocks * 1024) / PAGE);
    var have = memory.buffer.byteLength / PAGE;
    if (pages > have) memory.grow(pages - have); /* RangeError bila gagal */

    var u8 = new Uint8Array(memory.buffer);
    u8.set(password, pwdPtr);
    u8.set(salt, saltPtr);
    var rc = inst.exports.argon2id_hash(pwdPtr, password.length, saltPtr, salt.length, t, memKiB, p, hashLen, outPtr, memPtr);
    if (rc !== 0) throw new Error("Parameter Argon2id tidak valid");
    var out = u8.slice(outPtr, outPtr + hashLen);
    u8.fill(0); /* bersihkan sandi dan memori kerja */
    return out;
  }

  root.__KDF = { argon2id: argon2id };
})(typeof self !== "undefined" ? self : globalThis);
</script>

16h.01"}]]};
  var SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  }

  function hydrateIcons(root) {

  function swapIcon(id, name) {

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Konstanta                                                           */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  var VERSION = 1;
  var T_COST = 4;
  var PARALLELISM = 1;
  var HASH_LEN = 32;
  var SALT_LEN = 16;
  var IV_LEN = 12;
  var TAG_LEN = 16;
  var HEADER_LEN = 3;
  var MIN_PASSWORD = 12;

  var T_MAX = 10;

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Base85 (alfabet RFC 1924), 4 byte -> 5 karakter                     */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  var ALPHABET = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%&()*+-;<=>?@^_`{|}~";
  var LOOKUP = new Map();
  for (var ai = 0; ai < ALPHABET.length; ai++) LOOKUP.set(ALPHABET[ai], ai);

  function b85encode(bytes) {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 4) {
      var rem = Math.min(4, bytes.length - i);
      var v = 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) v = v * 256 + (k < rem ? bytes[i + k] : 0);
      var chars = ["", "", "", "", ""];
      for (var d = 4; d >= 0; d--) { chars[d] = ALPHABET[v % 85]; v = Math.floor(v / 85); }
      /* grup parsial (rem byte) -> rem+1 karakter */
      out.push(rem === 4 ? chars.join("") : chars.slice(0, rem + 1).join(""));
    }
    return out.join("");
  }

  function b85decode(text) {
    var s = text.replace(/\s+/g, "");
    var n = s.length, rest = n % 5;
    if (rest === 1) throw new Error("Panjang Base85 tidak valid.");
    var out = new Uint8Array(Math.floor(n / 5) * 4 + (rest ? rest - 1 : 0));
    var o = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i += 5) {
      var len = Math.min(5, n - i), v = 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        /* grup parsial diisi digit maksimum (84 = '~'), bukan 0 */
        var d = 84;
        if (k < len) {
          d = LOOKUP.get(s[i + k]);
          if (d === undefined) throw new Error("Karakter Base85 tidak valid: \"" + s[i + k] + "\".");
        }

      catch (e) { if (!(e && e.infra)) throw e; }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* UI                                                                  */

  var TAB_BASE = "flex-1 h-9 rounded-full text-[13px] font-semibold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ";
  var TAB_ON = TAB_BASE + "bg-[var(--ink)] text-[var(--bg)] shadow";
  var TAB_OFF = TAB_BASE + "text-[var(--ink-2)] hover:text-[var(--ink)]";
  var STATUS_OK = "mt-3 mono text-[11px] text-[var(--ink-2)] bg-[var(--surface-2)] border border-[var(--border)] rounded-[10px] px-3 py-2";
  var STATUS_ERR = "mt-3 mono text-[11px] text-[var(--ink)] bg-[var(--red-bg)] border border-[var(--red-border)] rounded-[10px] px-3 py-2";

  var state = { mode: "enc", busy: false, results: { enc: null, dec: null } };
  var timer = null, startedAt = 0, creep = null;

  function setStatus(msg, isError) {
    var el = $("status");
    el.className = isError ? STATUS_ERR : STATUS_OK;
    el.textContent = msg || "";
    el.hidden = !msg || state.busy;
  }

  function setWarning(msg) {
    var box = $("warnings");
    box.textContent = "";
    if (!msg) return;
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "mt-3 rounded-[12px] border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 px-3 py-2.5 flex gap-2";
    wrap.appendChild(svgIcon("shield-alert", "w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0"));
    var p = document.createElement("p");
    p.className = "text-[11px] leading-[1.5] text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200";
    p.textContent = msg;
    wrap.appendChild(p);
    box.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  function setBar(pct) { $("busy-bar").style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)) + "%"; }

  function tick() {
    var now = performance.now();
    $("busy-elapsed").textContent = ((now - startedAt) / 1000).toFixed(1) + "s";
    if (creep) setBar(creep.from + (creep.to - creep.from) * (1 - Math.exp(-(now - creep.t0) / creep.tau)));
  }

  function setBusy(on, text) {
    state.busy = on;
    $("btn-run").disabled = on;
    $("busy").hidden = !on;
    if (on) {
      $("status").hidden = true;
      $("busy-text").textContent = text || "";
      if (!timer) {
        startedAt = performance.now();
        setBar(3);
        tick();
        timer = setInterval(tick, 100);
      }
    } else if (timer) {
      clearInterval(timer);

      creep = null;
    }

  function stage(text, pct) { $("busy-text").textContent = text; creep = null; if (pct != null) setBar(pct); }
  function stageKdf(text) {
    $("busy-text").textContent = text;
    creep = { from: 12, to: 92, t0: performance.now(), tau: 3000 };
  }

  function showResult() {
    var res = state.results[state.mode];
    $("result").hidden = !res;
    if (!res) return;
    $("output").value = res.text;
    $("result-label").textContent = state.mode === "enc" ? "Hasil Enkripsi Base85 (ringkas)" : "Hasil Dekripsi Plaintext";
    var sizes = $("sizes");
    sizes.hidden = state.mode !== "enc";
    if (state.mode === "enc") {
      $("len-b64").textContent = res.b64Len;
      $("len-b85").textContent = res.b85Len;
      $("len-save").textContent = res.save.toFixed(2);
    }
  }

  function showStats(res) {
    if (!res) {
      $("st-ram").textContent = "256 MB";
      $("st-ram-sub").textContent = "paranoid";
      $("st-time").textContent = "—";
      $("st-save").textContent = "—";
      return;
    }
    $("st-ram").textContent = (res.memKiB / 1024) + " MB";
    $("st-ram-sub").textContent = res.memKiB < MEM_CHAIN[0] ? "fallback" : "paranoid";
    $("st-time").textContent = (res.ms / 1000).toFixed(2) + "s";

  }

  function friendlyError(e) {
    var msg = (e && e.message) || String(e);
    if (e && (e.name === "CompileError" || /WebAssembly|wasm|unsafe-eval|Content Security/i.test(msg)) && !isMemoryError(e)) {
      return "Browser memblokir WebAssembly (kemungkinan kebijakan CSP/pratinjau). Buka file ini langsung di browser.";
    }
    return msg;
  }

  function setMode(mode) {
    if (state.busy || mode === state.mode) return;
    state.mode = mode;
    var enc = mode === "enc";
    $("tab-enc").className = enc ? TAB_ON : TAB_OFF;
    $("tab-dec").className = enc ? TAB_OFF : TAB_ON;
    $("input-label").textContent = enc ? "Pesan Rahasia" : "Hasil Enkripsi Base85";
    $("input").placeholder = enc
      ? "Tulis pesan yang ingin dienkripsi dengan mode paranoid..."
      : "Tempel string Base85 hasil enkripsi di sini...";
    $("run-label").textContent = enc ? "Enkripsi Paranoid" : "Dekripsi";
    swapIcon("run-icon", enc ? "lock" : "lock-open");
    setWarning("");
    showResult();
    showStats(state.results[mode]);
    setStatus(enc ? "Mode enkripsi aktif — siap mengunci pesan." : "Mode dekripsi aktif — tempel Base85.");
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Enkripsi                                                            */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  async function encrypt() {
    var text = $("input").value, pwdStr = $("pwd").value;
    if (!text.trim()) { setStatus("Pesan kosong.", true); return; }
    if (!pwdStr) { setStatus("Sandi wajib diisi.", true); return; }
    if (Array.from(pwdStr).length < MIN_PASSWORD) { setStatus("Sandi minimal " + MIN_PASSWORD + " karakter.", true); return; }

    state.results.enc = null;
    showResult(); showStats(null); setWarning("");
    setBusy(true, "Menyiapkan enkripsi...");
    var pwd = new TextEncoder().encode(pwdStr.normalize("NFKC"));
    var keyBytes = null;
    try {
      var salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(SALT_LEN));
      var iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(IV_LEN));
      var memKiB = 0, t0 = performance.now();

      for (var i = 0; i < MEM_CHAIN.length; i++) {
        stageKdf("Argon2id " + (MEM_CHAIN[i] / 1024) + "MB, t=" + T_COST + "...");
        try { keyBytes = await deriveKey(pwd, salt, MEM_CHAIN[i]); memKiB = MEM_CHAIN[i]; break; }
        catch (e) {
          if (isMemoryError(e) && i < MEM_CHAIN.length - 1) {
            stage("Gagal alokasi " + (MEM_CHAIN[i] / 1024) + "MB, mencoba " + (MEM_CHAIN[i + 1] / 1024) + "MB...", 10);
            continue;
          }
          if (isMemoryError(e)) throw new Error("Perangkat tidak mampu mengalokasi memori untuk Argon2id (minimal " + (MEM_CHAIN[i] / 1024) + "MB).");
          throw e;
        }
      }
      var kdfMs = performance.now() - t0;

      stage("Enkripsi AES-GCM 256-bit...", 96);
      var header = new Uint8Array([VERSION, Math.round(Math.log2(memKiB)), T_COST]);
      var key = await aesImport(keyBytes, "encrypt");
      var ct = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
        { name: "AES-GCM", iv: iv, additionalData: header, tagLength: TAG_LEN * 8 },
        key, new TextEncoder().encode(text)));

      var packet = new Uint8Array(HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN + IV_LEN + ct.length);
      packet.set(header, 0);
      packet.set(salt, HEADER_LEN);
      packet.set(iv, HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN);
      packet.set(ct, HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN + IV_LEN);

      var b85 = b85encode(packet);
      var b64Len = Math.ceil(packet.length / 3) * 4;
      var res = { text: b85, memKiB: memKiB, ms: kdfMs, b64Len: b64Len, b85Len: b85.length, save: (1 - b85.length / b64Len) * 100 };
      state.results.enc = res;
      setBar(100);
      setBusy(false);
      showResult(); showStats(res);
      if (memKiB < MEM_CHAIN[0]) {
        setWarning("Perangkat tidak mampu alokasi 256MB. Otomatis turun ke " + (memKiB / 1024) +
          "MB (tercatat di header, tetap bisa didekripsi). Tetap aman, tapi level paranoid turun.");
      }
      setStatus("Selesai dalam " + (kdfMs / 1000).toFixed(2) + "s");
    } catch (e) {
      setBusy(false);
      setStatus("Gagal enkripsi: " + friendlyError(e), true);
    } finally {
      pwd.fill(0);
      if (keyBytes) keyBytes.fill(0);
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Dekripsi                                                            */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  async function decrypt() {
    var raw = $("input").value, pwdStr = $("pwd").value;
    if (!raw.trim()) { setStatus("Masukkan hasil enkripsi Base85.", true); return; }
    if (!pwdStr) { setStatus("Sandi wajib diisi.", true); return; }

    state.results.dec = null;
    showResult(); showStats(null); setWarning("");
    setBusy(true, "Membaca data...");
    var pwd = new TextEncoder().encode(pwdStr.normalize("NFKC"));
    var keyBytes = null;
    try {
      var data = b85decode(raw);
      if (data.length < HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN + IV_LEN + TAG_LEN) throw new Error("Data terlalu pendek, bukan format valid.");
      var header = data.slice(0, HEADER_LEN);
      if (header[0] !== VERSION) throw new Error("Versi format tidak dikenal (" + header[0] + "). Data ini bukan hasil alat ini.");
      var logm = header[1], t = header[2];
      if (logm < LOGM_MIN || logm > LOGM_MAX || t < 1 || t > T_MAX) throw new Error("Parameter pada header tidak valid.");
      var memKiB = Math.pow(2, logm);
      if (t !== T_COST) throw new Error("Parameter t pada header (" + t + ") tidak didukung versi ini.");
      var salt = data.slice(HEADER_LEN, HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN);
      var iv = data.slice(HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN, HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN + IV_LEN);
      var ct = data.slice(HEADER_LEN + SALT_LEN + IV_LEN);

      var t0 = performance.now();
      stageKdf("Argon2id " + (memKiB / 1024) + "MB, t=" + t + "...");
      try { keyBytes = await deriveKey(pwd, salt, memKiB); }
      catch (e) {
        if (isMemoryError(e)) throw new Error("Perangkat ini tidak mampu mengalokasi " + (memKiB / 1024) + "MB yang dibutuhkan data ini. Coba di perangkat dengan RAM lebih besar.");
        throw e;
      }
      var kdfMs = performance.now() - t0;

      stage("Dekripsi AES-GCM...", 96);
      var key = await aesImport(keyBytes, "decrypt");
      var plain;
      try {
        plain = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
          { name: "AES-GCM", iv: iv, additionalData: header, tagLength: TAG_LEN * 8 }, key, ct));
      } catch (e) { throw new Error("Sandi salah, atau data rusak/diubah."); }
      var textOut;
      try { textOut = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(plain); }
      catch (e) { throw new Error("Dekripsi berhasil, tetapi isinya bukan teks UTF-8 yang valid."); }

      var res = { text: textOut, memKiB: memKiB, ms: kdfMs };
      state.results.dec = res;
      setBar(100);
      setBusy(false);
      showResult(); showStats(res);
      setStatus("Dekripsi berhasil " + (kdfMs / 1000).toFixed(2) + "s");
    } catch (e) {
      setBusy(false);
      setStatus("Gagal dekripsi: " + friendlyError(e), true);
    } finally {
      pwd.fill(0);
      if (keyBytes) keyBytes.fill(0);
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  /* Clipboard & event                                                   */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  async function copyText(text) {
    if (!text) { setStatus("Belum ada yang bisa disalin."); return; }
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      } else {
        throw new Error("no clipboard api");
      }
      setStatus("Disalin ke clipboard (lokal).");
    } catch (e) {
      var ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = text;
      ta.style.position = "fixed";
      ta.style.opacity = "0";
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try { document.execCommand("copy"); setStatus("Disalin ke clipboard (lokal)."); }
      catch (e2) { setStatus("Gagal copy otomatis, seleksi manual.", true); }
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }
  }

  function currentResultText() {
    var res = state.results[state.mode];
    return res ? res.text : "";
  }

  hydrateIcons(document);
  $("tab-enc").addEventListener("click", function () { setMode("enc"); });
  $("tab-dec").addEventListener("click", function () { setMode("dec"); });
  $("toggle-pwd").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var show = $("pwd").type === "password";
    $("pwd").type = show ? "text" : "password";
    swapIcon("eye-icon", show ? "eye-off" : "eye");
  });
  $("input").addEventListener("input", function () { $("char-count").textContent = $("input").value.length; });
  $("btn-run").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (state.busy) return;
    (state.mode === "enc" ? encrypt : decrypt)();
  });
  $("btn-clear").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (state.busy) return;
    $("input").value = "";
    $("char-count").textContent = "0";
    state.results = { enc: null, dec: null };
    showResult(); showStats(null); setWarning("");
    setStatus("Dibersihkan.");
  });
  $("btn-copy").addEventListener("click", function () { copyText(currentResultText()); });
  $("btn-copy-out").addEventListener("click", function () { copyText(currentResultText()); });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
